title: Identity computation with bounded space
statement: There are a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every Boolean input $x$, $M$ outputs $x$ and halts within $c(|x|+1)$ steps. For every input $x$ and every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the space used by $M$ by time $t$ is at most $c$.
